personality_one_liner: A cinematic, unhurried, and premium chauffeur experience emphasizing deep contrast, elegant typography, and frosted glass over dark surfaces.

spacing.rule: Use generous margins and padding to let the content breathe. Do not crowd elements. Rely on spacing and blur rather than hard borders to separate sections.

do's: Use blur on bottom sheets over map/imagery.
Use glass on floating notification banners and sticky headers.
Ensure a dark tinted base (≥75% surface) under the blur so text remains perfectly readable.
dont's: Do not blur standard form fields or text regions.
Do not stack more than two glass surfaces.

screens.layout: Background is a dark-themed map view. A persistent, draggable glassmorphic Bottom Sheet covers the lower 60% of the screen. The sheet contains: 1) Pick-up and Drop-off location fields (text input that can open a map selector), 2) A horizontal scrolling list of Car Types (VIP, Luxury, Normal) using large, cinematic car imagery with prices, 3) Date/time picker, 4) Notes field, and 5) Sticky brandPrimary 'Request Ride' button at the bottom.

screens.layout: Utility-first but still premium dark mode. A flat list of cards. Each card represents a customer order showing: Customer Name, Car Type, From/To locations, Date/Time, Price, and Notes. The card has a dual-action footer: subtle 'Reject' (surfaceTertiary) and prominent 'Accept' (brandPrimary). Uses a sticky header with a glass effect.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a premium 'Glass / Luxe' aesthetic in DARK mode. Do not use generic blue/indigo; rely on Midnight Black (#09090B) with Antique Gold (#C5A059) accents.

RTL & Arabic Support: Ensure layouts are RTL-friendly by strictly using React Native logical properties (paddingStart, marginEnd, borderStartWidth, etc.) instead of directional ones (paddingLeft, marginRight).
Use a single-screen booking pattern for the customer. Consolidate locations, car type selection, and datetime into one Bottom Sheet over a map, rather than a multi-step form.

Apply frosted glass (expo-blur) for the booking bottom sheet and any sticky headers or notification banners. Ensure the glass has a tinted background layer (rgba(9, 9, 11, 0.75)) to guarantee text readability.
Whenever displaying imagery with text overlay (like car selection cards), MUST apply a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface/surfaceInverse) underneath the text for contrast.
Do NOT use pure white backgrounds. Adhere strictly to the provided color palette (surface, surfaceSecondary).
Provide a toggle on the Auth screen to allow users to sign in/register as either a Customer or a Company Admin.
